# The Mayor

> The Mayor is an AI chief of staff for local business owners. Slogan: "Mayor. Talk to your business." The owner talks to The Mayor in plain language, by voice or text, and The Mayor helps run the front desk: answering missed calls, texting back leads, handling bookings, follow-ups, and a weekly posting plan for the business's social channels.

## Who it is for

Local service businesses — salons, restaurants, plumbing and HVAC, dental practices, auto repair, pet grooming, and med spas — where the owner is also the front desk.

## What it does

- Answers missed calls and texts back leads automatically once the business number is connected. Automatic text-backs are sent through Telnyx; Twilio numbers connect for voice calls.
- Manages bookings, reminders, and follow-ups, and keeps the day's money in view.
- Trendpost: builds a 7-day posting plan — per day an angle, a ready-to-use draft in the business's voice, and a best-time slot. The owner approves, edits, or skips every post; nothing posts without the owner's approval.
- Proactive suggestions for slow hours, lapsed customers, and missed-call follow-ups — each one review-gated by the owner.

## Pricing (as of October 2026 — the live catalog is at https://mayor.mehyar.us/pricing)

- Free: $0. 100 reply attempts a month, 10 microphone minutes.
- Pro: $99/month. 1,000 reply attempts a month, 120 microphone minutes.
- Founding cohort: the first 25 businesses get Pro at $79.20/month, locked for life while the subscription stays active. Join from the Pricing page (https://mayor.mehyar.us/pricing) — it leads to https://mayor.mehyar.us/billing?plan=founding. (Existing subscribers keep the rate they signed up at.)
- Top-up packs: $4, $8, and $12.
- Extensive business audit: one-time $330.
- Conversation estimates figure roughly 10 replies per conversation (Free is about 10 conversations a month; Pro is about 100).

## Free resource

The Missed-Call Revenue Checklist is a one-page checklist for finding where missed calls leak revenue at a shop. It is offered with the free monthly email signup at https://mayor.mehyar.us/sales and can be read at https://mayor.mehyar.us/missed-call-checklist.

## Modules

Two add-on modules extend The Mayor, each arriving with the module launch (pricing is announced at launch):

- CashText: invoice by conversation. The owner says "invoice Maria $400" and The Mayor drafts the invoice on a card; nothing sends until the owner approves it, and the invoice is sent through the owner's own connected Stripe account. Overdue invoices get chase drafts the owner approves one by one — a chase re-sends the same invoice with a labelled copy-paste draft — and a Friday cash summary lands on the owner's Desk. A scripted interactive demo (no real data) is at https://mayor.mehyar.us/cashtext-demo
- LeadProof: evidence-backed business leads. The owner describes who they want to reach and buys a pack of up to 25 local businesses; every lead carries the source behind it and a "why now" drawn from that evidence. If fewer than 15 qualify, the pack credit comes back automatically. LeadProof is export only — The Mayor never contacts the leads — and it sources businesses only.
